verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Okta works as an SSO identity provider that connects users to multiple service providers after one sign-in (okta-docs-8, okta-docs-15). It also mentions vendors building 'Okta integrations' (okta-docs-16), which hints at an integration ecosystem. Nothing in the pack shows a catalog of pre-built SAML/OIDC apps, its size, or quick setup times. Missing for 10: evidence of a pre-built app integration catalog, evidence of its scale (thousands of apps), SAML/OIDC template coverage, evidence that apps connect in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
